hero.eyebrow: Day trips, activities & transfers from Agadir
hero.h1: What kind of day do you want?
hero.lede: Quads on the dunes, camels by the Souss river, Marrakech or Essaouira for the day, the airport run at the end of your holiday. Tell us the day you have in mind. We probably know what to do — with pickup from your hotel on almost every trip.
hero.note: Twenty-odd kinds of day. One desk.

guide.title: Seven moods, twenty-four days out of Agadir
guide.none_here: Nothing that length in this mood — try another, or ask us.

sand.name: Sand & engines
sand.intro: South of Agadir the tracks run through Berber villages and out onto dunes by the ocean at Tifnit. Bring sunglasses; you'll get sand everywhere.
sand.note: Quads, a sandboard and a camel in one afternoon? Ask us — we combine.

salt.name: Salt water
salt.intro: Agadir lives on its bay. Get on it, get in it, or follow the coast south for a long day by the sea.

hooves.name: Hooves, humps & crocodiles
hooves.intro: Camels and horses out to the Souss river, where flamingos feed in the shallows. And for the kids, a park full of Nile crocodiles.

medina.name: Medinas & markets
medina.intro: Ramparts, souks and big old squares: Marrakech and Essaouira for the day, or Agadir's own port and Souk El Had in a morning.
medina.note: Marrakech is a long one: out at 7, home around 9.

valleys.name: Palms, gorges & mountain villages
valleys.intro: Inland the air changes. Palm-lined gorges up the Imouzzer road, the walls of Taroudant, granite villages around Tafraout.
valleys.note: In summer we go to Paradise Valley in the morning. The afternoons are scorching.

slow.name: Go slow
slow.intro: Not every day needs an engine. Steam and argan oil, a long dinner with music, a balloon at sunrise if the dates work.

further.name: Two days, one night away
further.intro: Sleep in the desert at Zagora or El Borj, or do Marrakech and Essaouira together. These run on request — message us for dates.

quad.name: Quad biking
quad.line: South of the city, through a Berber village and onto the dunes by Tifnit beach. About 90 minutes of riding, briefing first.

buggy.name: Buggy ride
buggy.line: Two-seat buggies through forest and dunes with a mint-tea stop. Morning or afternoon; good with kids beside you.

sandboarding.name: Sandboarding
sandboarding.line: Boards and a big dune. Best paired with the quads — ask us.

little-desert.name: The Little Desert by 4x4
little-desert.line: Dunes and a short camel ride, the Souss-Massa coast, lunch in a Berber family's home, then the old medina of Tiznit. Out 08:30, back around 17:30.

jet-ski.name: Jet ski
jet-ski.line: Twenty minutes, half an hour or a full hour on Agadir bay.

boat-trip.name: Boat trip: fish, swim, lunch
boat-trip.line: Out from the marina with fishing gear on board, a swim stop, then fish grilled on deck with Moroccan salad. Back at your hotel early afternoon.

surf.name: Surf lessons
surf.line: Beginner and intermediate lessons, with pickup from your hotel in Agadir. Kids from about seven — ask us.

legzira.name: Legzira & Massa, with lunch
legzira.line: Aglou beach, free time on Legzira's red-cliff beach, a fish lunch by the ocean, home via Tiznit and the dunes. Out 08:00, back around 18:00.

camel.name: Camel ride by the Souss river
camel.line: From the ranch out to the river and the flamingos, past eucalyptus and a glimpse of the royal palace.

camel-bbq.name: Camel ride & barbecue dinner
camel-bbq.line: Two hours on a camel to the river mouth, then dinner: barbecue, tagine or vegetarian.

horse.name: Horse riding
horse.line: Along the Souss river, past the flamingos and through the eucalyptus woods, with a guide.

crocoparc.name: Crocoparc
crocoparc.line: Nile crocodiles and big gardens about half an hour from town. We collect you from your hotel.

marrakech.name: Marrakech for the day
marrakech.line: Bahia Palace, the Koutoubia gardens, the souks and Jemaa el-Fna. Out 07:00, home around 21:00. Lunch isn't included.

essaouira.name: Essaouira for the day
essaouira.line: Goats in the argan trees on the way, then the port, the Skala ramparts and the medina with a guide, and free time. Lunch is up to you.

city-tour.name: Agadir city tour
city-tour.line: Three hours: the Marina, the fishing port, the view from Agadir Oufella, an argan cooperative and an hour in Souk El Had.

paradise-valley.name: Paradise Valley
paradise-valley.line: Up the Imouzzer road to a palm-lined gorge between argan, almond and olive trees, with free time in Imouzzer village.

taroudant.name: Taroudant & Tiout
taroudant.line: Taroudant's ramparts and souks, then the palm grove and kasbah at Tiout. Home by another road.

tafraout.name: Tafraout & Tiznit
tafraout.line: Granite country: the Ameln valley, the painted rocks near Tafraout, then Tiznit's silver medina.

hammam.name: Hammam & massage
hammam.line: A traditional hammam, then an hour's massage with argan oil. We drive you there and back.

berber-evening.name: Berber evening & dinner
berber-evening.line: Dinner under caidal tents — pastilla, couscous, mint tea — with musicians, dancers and fantasia riders.

balloon.name: Hot-air balloon
balloon.line: A sunrise flight with mint tea before and breakfast after. Ask us for dates.

zagora.name: Zagora desert, 2 days
zagora.line: Over to the Draa valley via Taroudant and Taliouine, a camel to camp, a night in the desert, sunrise on the dunes.

el-borj.name: El Borj desert, 2 days
el-borj.line: Tiznit and Legzira on the way, sunset in the El Borj dunes and a night in tents; camels and the Tighmert palm grove next day.

marrakech-essaouira.name: Marrakech & Essaouira, 2 days
marrakech-essaouira.line: Marrakech's palaces and souks, a night in a hotel, then Essaouira's medina and the coast road home.

transfers.title: Airport transfers
transfers.text: Agadir airport to your hotel and back. Marrakech, Casablanca and Essaouira airports to Agadir. One price per vehicle, for 1–3 or 4–7 people. Landing late? Ask us.
